mustFix.fix: Size the drawing box to the symbol's own ratio (d-house viewBox 600×240: aspect-ratio 600/240 on the svg, preserveAspectRatio xMidYMid meet, overflow visible) instead of the fixed clamp(320px,52vw,620px) height with 10% bottom padding; confirm the whole porch, both hotspots and both legend lines show in 1440-first/rm-full.

elevate.move: Let the cut sheet discipline the type: keep tracked mono caps only for the short CUT nn label and set the dimension strings in tabular lowercase mono with real multiplication signs, so the page has three voices (display numerals, serif reading, small spec) instead of a wall of tracked caps.

Make the porch elevation the page's single off-grid moment: let the drawing break out of its band and overlap the porch-check panel below, and rebalance #proof so the big 4.9 figure anchors a column that the reviews hang from, removing both dead fields.
